title: Arrival & Registration
description: Have your ticket QR code and a photo ID ready. If you don't have a service exchange or karma yoga team yet, one will be assigned at check-in. Check-in hours to be confirmed.

title: Orientation & First Sessions
description: The program begins at 3:00 PM with an orientation and the first sessions. Details to be announced.

title: Opening Circle
description: Come open the space with us! Welcome home, welcome back. Join the teachers to open this Winter Solstice Celebration with music, laughter, meditation and joy.

title: Rise up sweet family dear!
description: Wake up, get cleaned up, get ready for Sadhana!

title: Aquarian Sadhana
description: Japji Sahib, a Kundalini Yoga kriya and the Aquarian Sadhana mantras. Come as you are, bring a blanket.

title: Gurdwara
description: Gurdwara is a sacred space of Shabad (sound current), sangat (community), and seva (service). Whether this is your first time or a treasured tradition, you're invited to sit together in remembrance, sing the Naam, and bathe the mind in Gurbani kirtan. All are welcome.

title: All-Camp Meditation & Karma Yoga Meetings
description: A short all-camp meditation, then meet your Karma Yoga or Service Exchange team. All attendees have a karma yoga: it keeps the event sustainable and flowing. Unsure of yours? Ask at the event office.

title: Kids Camp
description: Program for children and youth while the adults are in class. Parents check children in and out. Daily schedule to be announced.

title: WTY Monitors Meeting
description: During lunch. Interested in being a Monitor at White Tantric Yoga® (WTY)? A WTY Monitor must have attended at least one day of WTY, wear white clothing and a white head covering, and wear the Monitor ID marker. Monitors receive the same benefits of WTY as if they were doing the meditations with a partner.

title: Sat Nam Rasayan
description: Sat Nam Rasayan®: healing through awareness, in deep meditative silence. All camp together, no parallel classes, with a short break at 3:30 PM.
